newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel, Citybus in JV, share deals.
newsitem.headline: China Travel, Citybus in JV, share deals.

text.p: Tourism firm China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd and bus operator Citybus Group Ltd said on Friday they agreed to form a 50:50 joint venture with an initial investment of HK$100 million.
The new company, CTS Citybus Ltd, will promote and develop land passenger transport services across the China-Hong Kong border and within China, the firms said in a joint statement.

Such services currently operated by Citybus and China Travel will be merged and become part of the operations of the joint venture, which will also actively seek opportunities to step up land passenger transport services in China, the statement said.

China Travel, which specialises in tourism business in China, also agreed to buy 113.45 million new Citybus shares, representing 10 percent of the bus operator's enlarged issued share capital, at HK$2.18 each or for a total HK$247.32 million. The tourism group has undertaken to hold the new shares as long term investment.
In an agreemnt with CNT Group Ltd, Citybus' parent, China Travel has also agreed to take a 10 percent indirect investment in Citybus.
The share placement and the indirect investment together will take China Travel's interest in Citybus to 20 percent.

Citybus will use the proceeds as working capital for the local bus operation to strengthen its abiltiy to expand its existing local route networks and to undertake new projects in the future, the statement said.
China Travel is a unit of mainland tourism conglomerate China Travel Service.
Trading in shares of the three listed companies was suspended on Friday.
